links.targetTitle: The Pioneer Incentive Pool pays the Savings Rate on unreward
The Pioneer Chain Primitive funds a chain-level incentive po
A Pioneer Prime is credited with every untagged USDS balance

title: The Pioneer Incentive Pool pays a partner the Savings Rate on USDS that earns no rewards, turning unclaimed yield into partner revenue
content:
A.2.8.2.3.2.1 makes Keel eligible for a Pioneer Incentive Pool "calculated on a monthly basis as the Sky Savings Rate multiplied by all Unrewarded USDS on Solana," paid monthly from the Demand Side Buffer to a wallet controlled by the Pioneer Prime.

The elegance is in the base. Unrewarded USDS is stablecoin in circulation whose holders are *not* claiming savings yield — for Sky, that is retained margin. The formula hands that margin to the party that expanded circulation on that chain. Sky pays nothing it was not already prepared to pay if every holder had staked, so the incentive is close to costless at the margin while being highly motivating to the Pioneer.

The incentive it creates is specifically distribution into *passive* holding: wallet balances, payments, integrations where users hold USDS without seeking yield. A Pioneer optimizing this pool is not rewarded for driving users into the Savings Rate — that would shrink the unrewarded base and its own revenue.

That is the sharp edge worth naming: the metric rewards growth of idle supply and mildly penalizes converting holders into savers, so a Pioneer's local optimum can diverge from maximizing yield-bearing adoption. The chain-scoping (Solana only) keeps the exposure bounded to the territory the Pioneer actually opened.
description: Calculated monthly as Sky Savings Rate x all Unrewarded USDS on Solana and paid from the Demand Side Buffer, so the Pioneer's income rises with circulating-but-idle supply it helped create.
